0022600188.text: The Golden State Warriors, 4-3 and on a four-game winning streak, host the Miami Heat, who are 2-4 and riding a two-game win streak. The Warriors are without Al Horford (rest), Brandon Williams (quadriceps bruise), Gui Santos (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery). The season series has no games yet in 2026-27, while the teams split 1-1 in 2025-26, and the Warriors won their last meeting 135-112 in San Francisco on January 19, 2026.
